segments.title: Chương 181: Đại diện siêu rẻ
segments.content:
Chapter 184: 0181 An Ultra-Low-Priced Endorsement (Bonus Chapter for Alliance Leader Qi Wangyue)

"Super Girl contestants can't sign endorsements for now. There are contract disputes," Xie Yang said, taking out a legal newspaper. "CCTV's 'China Legal Report' was the first to report it, and now it's on several other newspapers."

Chen Guiliang picked up the paper and saw that the one with contract disputes was precisely Zhang Liangying.

Presumably, Tianyu had an insider who sold the information to reporters.

From the very beginning of the Super Girl competition in the regional divisions, contestants were required to sign various contracts with Tianyu. Only Zhang Liangying had been dragging her feet and refusing to sign.

By the time the competition came down to the final six advancing to the final five, she couldn't stall any longer.

At the same time, Mango TV and Tianyu were also getting anxious, afraid that Zhang Liangying would stand her ground and choose to withdraw from the competition.

The two sides compromised and signed a loose contract.

Now there were all sorts of different stories. Some said she had signed with Tianyu, others said she had signed with Warner Music. A whole host of other record companies were also sending people to inquire, trying to snatch up this hot commodity.

Xie Yang said, "We're planning to sign the third-place winner. There are still two shows left, so we don't know who the third-place winner will be yet."

"Given Tianyu's current situation, are they only accepting commercial deals in the name of the Super Girl group and not allowing any individual contestant to take on solo deals?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang was surprised. "How did you know?"

"Because performance, endorsement, and advertising contracts must all be signed or authorized by the artist," Chen Guiliang said. "Zhang Liangying won't even sign a standard contract. How could she possibly agree to sign an endorsement deal?"

It dawned on Xie Yang. "The talent show isn't over yet, so we can only blindly sign for a certain ranking. If any one of the contestants disagrees, this kind of cooperation is impossible to negotiate."

"Not bad, you catch on quick," Chen Guiliang smiled. "Before the Super Girl finale airs, send someone to wait at Tianyu. Sign Zhang Liangying to a three-year endorsement deal for 1.5 million."

"There's no way Tianyu or Zhang Liangying would agree, right?" Xie Yang thought Chen Guiliang was talking nonsense.

Chen Guiliang said, "Just send someone over. The worst that can happen is losing a little money on travel expenses."

Xie Yang left, bewildered.

During the military training for Peking University freshmen, the last two episodes of "Super Girl" finished airing.

The ratings exploded!

Some media outlets were surprised to find that while the champion and runner-up had accepted numerous endorsements, the second runner-up, Zhang Liangying, had gotten nothing. She could only participate in group activities as a Super Girl.

Luo Yi, who had been sent by Xie Yang to negotiate the endorsement, had already been left hanging by Tianyu for over a week.

He was about to return to Beijing when Tianyu suddenly approached him.

"Mr. Luo, your company's offer is still too low," the Tianyu representative said.

Luo Yi also thought it was too low, and didn't even think it was possible to secure the deal. He decided to go for broke. "This is all we're offering. 1.5 million yuan for a three-year endorsement. 300,000 yuan for one day of shooting."

"You really can't add any more?"

"I can't."

"Alright, let's sign the contract."

"Huh?"

Luo Yi felt like there was something wrong with his ears.

When the news got back to the company, Xie Yang was completely baffled, unable to figure it out.

He strode out of his office towards the elevator and went straight to the 10th floor.

Game Science had finally moved as well. Since a single floor didn't have enough office space, part of the company was on the 10th floor, and part was on the 11th.

Unlike ByteDance, ever since "Legends of the Three Kingdoms" started charging, Game Science had been profitable every month.

Even the mini-games on Xiaonei and Kaixin were non-exclusive licensed products from Game Science, requiring them to pay Game Science a share of the revenue every quarter.

Game Science's workforce was constantly expanding.

Especially for the side-scrolling game project meant to rival "DNF." It didn't even have a name yet, but it already had an 18-person project team.

Chen Guiliang was inspecting his new territory. Employees were constantly coming in and out, moving things from the old office.

"The endorsement deal is done," Xie Yang said. "They're faxing the contract over now for the company's legal team to confirm."

Chen Guiliang deliberately teased him, "Figured it out yet?"

Xie Yang shook his head. "Why would Tianyu agree? How could they possibly sign the Super Girl second runner-up to a three-year endorsement deal for just 1.5 million?"

Chen Guiliang called him over to the stairwell. "If you had a TV station and also controlled an entertainment agency, and a talent show you created became a massive hit, the top contestants would definitely see their value skyrocket. Would you sign all the contestants before the competition ends?"

"Of course I'd sign them. If I didn't, someone else would just reap the rewards for free," Xie Yang said.

Chen Guiliang asked again, "What if someone stubbornly refuses to sign?"

Xie Yang thought from the perspective of the TV station and agency. "If she won't sign, then make her withdraw from the competition!"

Chen Guiliang said, "You can't possibly sign every contestant during the audition phase. You have to wait until the competition reaches a certain stage to sign the ones who perform better. But what if a certain contestant who's already gained some fame keeps playing dumb and refuses to sign? What do you do? If she makes a scene, it'll definitely have a negative impact on the show."

Xie Yang said, "So Zhang Liangying's contract was the result of a compromise from both sides, and it could very well become invalid someday."

"Right," Chen Guiliang nodded.

"Then why did they only accept our endorsement deal?"

"Because our person was there waiting the whole time and could sign the contract quickly. Plus, our contract only requires Zhang Liangying to shoot for one day. Other businesses aren't so easygoing; they'd definitely have other activities attached."

Xie Yang completely understood: Tianyu and Zhang Liangying had completely fallen out! This advertising endorsement from ByteDance was the only contract Tianyu signed for Zhang Liangying.

To put it bluntly, it was like making use of a waste product.

And ByteDance's demands weren't high. Other than one day of shooting, there were no other activity requirements, so Zhang Liangying just had to hold her nose and accept it.

"You can predict the future, can't you?" Xie Yang was a little shocked.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Didn't I say so? Even if we hadn't signed it, we would have only lost a little on employee travel expenses."

As a reincarnator, Chen Guiliang didn't know much about Zhang Liangying, but he had heard the gossip about her and her husband, Feng Ke.

Tianyu Entertainment.

Feng Ke was carefully examining the friendly agreement.

The agreement stated:

For the next year, Zhang Liangying would nominally be an artist under Tianyu and must participate in all Super Girl activities. Zhang Liangying could sign her own commercial deals without giving Tianyu any of the profits. Tianyu could introduce commercial deals to Zhang Liangying, but could only charge a finder's fee.

After the one-year agreement expired, Zhang Liangying would be free to sign a management contract with another company. However, the record deal was not bound by this agreement; Zhang Liangying could freely sign a record deal at any time.

"There's no problem with the agreement," Feng Ke said.

The negotiation process for this friendly agreement had not been friendly at all; it was obtained through a mutually assured destruction approach. If she didn't sign, she wouldn't participate in any Super Girl activities, including the most important Super Girl concert tour.

Zhang Liangying immediately picked up a pen, ready to sign her name with a flourish.

"Wait, sign this endorsement contract first."

Zhang Liangying signed both the agreement and the contract.

ByteDance had really lucked out this time, signing a three-year endorsement deal for 1.5 million.

And for the next three years, because Zhang Liangying held tightly to her management contract, she wouldn't be able to get a single advertising endorsement. The ad and endorsement for Kaixin.com would be her one and only for the next three years.

Truly exclusive.

Walking out of the reception room, Zhang Liangying saw Luo Yi and handed him a signed copy of the contract.

"Miss Zhang, could we talk for a moment?" Luo Yi had just received a new task.

"Let's go."

The two of them found a coffee shop. Zhang Liangying was still wearing a hat to cover her face.

Luo Yi promised, "This endorsement contract is by no means kicking you when you're down. We have other compensation for you."

Zhang Liangying didn't speak.

Feng Ke asked, "What kind of compensation?"

Luo Yi said, "When we shoot the commercial, we will invite Mr. Mao Geping to personally create an image for Miss Zhang. The image design fee, makeup fee, hairstyling fee, and wardrobe rental fee will amount to 150,000 yuan!"

"That expensive?" Zhang Liangying said in surprise.

Luo Yi smiled. "I guarantee it will give Miss Zhang a brand-new look, one on par with international female stars."

At this time, Zhang Liangying's styling was very ordinary, and her skin was a bit dark, which didn't fit the image Chen Guiliang had in mind for the ad.

Luo Yi added, "Mr. Feng should understand. To go from a Super Girl contestant to a real star, image and temperament are very important. I hope that before the shoot, Miss Zhang will watch more movies and learn how to become more elegant."

"Understood," Feng Ke agreed on her behalf.

In a blink of an eye, school had started, but it was still too early to shoot the commercial. Zhang Liangying had too many Super Girl activities and couldn't get away at all.

The WAP version of Kaixin.com had begun testing, with Weibo as its main feature.

There were very few users.

No amount of promotion within the Kaixin website seemed to work.
